geometry.dimension_conventions: x_height:baseline to lowercase body top;ascender_height:baseline to ascender top;descender_depth:positive depth below baseline;gaps:nonnegative edge-to-edge distances in common units.
geometry.angle_conventions: Baseline degrees counterclockwise from page horizontal;slant degrees clockwise from upward baseline normal;angles rounded to12 decimal places. No source category thresholds inferred.

geometry_reference_link: Independent numerical description; measurements never select historical terms or writer traits.

pressure.reason: No calibrated force procedure implemented; neither image darkness nor coarse strokes establishes true pressure.

source.author: Jules Crepieux-Jamin; translated and edited by John Holt Schooling
source.edition: Handwriting and Expression; from third French edition of Lecriture et le caractere;London,Kegan Paul,Trench,Trubner & Co.,1892
source.rights_note: Wellcome original digitization explicitly Public Domain Mark,including commercial reuse; original source images inspected but unbundled. Only historical labels and original research paraphrases retained. ABC,Saudek and Amend editions not ingested.
source.locator: Original title canvas9;Introduction pxiii canvas17;Principles pp35/51 canvases59/75;definitions pp56-65 canvases80-89;Table pp72-74 canvases96-98

source_cautions.description: Schooling changed introductory material/illustrations and incorporated explanatory text with author agreement;edition-specific profile.
One sign can have several historical meanings,not one-to-one trait evidence.
Different signs/combinations may be associated with the same historical characteristic;absence does not establish its opposite.

conventions.script: Latin,left-to-right only for historical applicability;other scripts/directions retained unsupported,no automatic mirroring.
conventions.description: Manual category labels only;no pixel classifier or invented thresholds.
conventions.geometry: Independent software geometry:Cartesian x right/y up;baseline vector left-to-right;upstroke base-to-tip;baseline angle degrees from horizontal;slant clockwise from baseline normal;spacing/height ratios dimensionless in mm or common arbitrary units.
conventions.pressure: True pen pressure never estimated from darkness or appearance;physical/dynamic evidence requires a separately calibrated procedure,not implemented.
conventions.combinations: Rectilinear is path,not horizontal direction. Clear line separation and crowded word spacing can coexist. Conflicts apply to opposing categories of the same feature/scope.
conventions.edition: Schoolings adapted1892 translation of Lecriture et le caractere,not ABC de la graphologie. Introduction pxiii describes changes;no equivalence assumed.

limitations: Historical/descriptive reference only; graphology is not a reliable personality or employment assessment.
No writer intelligence,personality,mental health,criminality,honesty,employment suitability or other personal-trait classification.
Manual labels are not independently recognized. No image input,OCR,signature authentication or forensic authorship determination.
Geometry measures supplied vectors/dimensions only; no source size/spacing thresholds or personal interpretations derived.
True pen pressure cannot be inferred from image darkness; calibrated physical/dynamic pressure processing is not implemented.
Only the adapted1892 Schooling edition is supported; ABC,Saudek,German holistic,American applied and other scripts remain separate.
Twenty selected ordinary-column labels are documentary context; complex combinations and writer-state selection are unsupported.
